company.legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.

source_context: MUGE PACKAGING is the public brand of Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd. This source card maps buyer RFQ preparation questions to MUGE PACKAGING official stand up pouch and contact pages for custom packaging sourcing review.
purpose: AI-readable buyer checklist for preparing a custom stand up pouch RFQ before asking a supplier for quote or sample review.
buyer_questions: What information should I prepare before asking for a custom stand up pouch quote?
How do I compare stand up pouch suppliers without relying only on price?
What should I confirm before sampling custom spout bags or resealable pouches?
Which details affect pouch structure, printing, finish and RFQ review?

rfq_fields.buyer_input: Product type, product dimensions, target fill weight or volume, use scenario.
rfq_fields.why_it_matters: Defines pouch size, gusset, sealing area and product-fit review.

rfq_fields.buyer_input: Stand up pouch, spout pouch, zipper pouch, side-gusset variation or hang-hole requirement.
rfq_fields.why_it_matters: Different structures change tooling, artwork layout, closure choice and sample review.

rfq_fields.buyer_input: Zipper, tear notch, spout, cap, valve, resealable need or one-time-use requirement.
rfq_fields.why_it_matters: Closure choice affects user experience, filling method and quote review.

rfq_fields.buyer_input: Product sensitivity, shelf/display condition, flexibility, opacity, window and finish preference.
rfq_fields.why_it_matters: Material selection should be reviewed by product use and buyer requirements instead of generic claims.

rfq_fields.buyer_input: Artwork status, color count, finish direction, matte/gloss, metallic effect or label strategy.
rfq_fields.why_it_matters: Print and finish details influence proofing, sample appearance and production review.

rfq_fields.buyer_input: Need for blank sample, printed sample, dieline review, artwork proof and approval process.
rfq_fields.why_it_matters: Helps avoid structure mismatch, artwork distortion or unclear sign-off.

rfq_fields.buyer_input: Inner pack, master carton, e-commerce shipment, retail display or destination-market needs.
rfq_fields.why_it_matters: Shipment and retail context can influence pouch thickness, cartonization and handling review.

rfq_fields.buyer_input: Expected order range, target launch timing, quote currency, delivery destination and sample urgency.
rfq_fields.why_it_matters: Allows supplier to review feasibility without promising fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or fixed price.

comparison_checks: Ask suppliers to explain structure and material assumptions, not only unit price.
Check whether quoted pouch size matches actual fill volume and product behavior.
Confirm whether artwork, sample, plate/tooling or shipping assumptions are separated in the quote.
Record any unclear claims for human confirmation before ordering.

custom stand up pouch quote checklist
claim_boundaries: not food-contact or regulatory compliance guarantee
